note: Activity bar and bottom-left controls -- renders fixed operator vocabulary: Explorer, Search, Source Control, Run, Extensions, Accounts, Settings
Viewlet title bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary: 'Explorer' and toolbar controls
Pane headers in the sidebar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary: 'Open Editors', 'Timeline', and action buttons (New File, New Folder, Refresh, Collapse All)
Editor tab bar chrome -- renders fixed operator vocabulary: 'Getting Started' (default page name) and tab action buttons (Close, Split, More)
Getting Started page -- renders fixed operator vocabulary: product name, subtitle, category titles, descriptions, and action buttons
Status bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary: host type, SCM status, problems count, forwarded ports, notifications, and screen reader mode
Native menu bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary: File, Edit, Selection, View, Go, Run, Terminal, Help
